p: hath believed our report: The prophet shows that very few will receive their preaching from Christ, and from their deliverance by him, Joh 12:38, Ro 10:16.
arm of the LORD revealed: Meaning, that no one can believe but whose hearts God touches with the virtue of his Holy Spirit.
root out of a dry: The beginning of Christ's kingdom will be small and contemptible in the sight of man, but it will grow wonderfully and flourish before God.
grief: Which was by God's singular providence for the comfort of sinners, He 4:15.
our sorrows: That is, the punishment due to our sins, for which he has both suffered and made satisfaction, Mt 8:17, 1Pe 2:24.
stricken: We judge evil, thinking that he was punished for his own sins, and not for ours.
chastisement for our peace was upon: He was chastised for our reconciliation, 1Co 15:3.
iniquity of us all: Meaning, the punishment of our iniquity, and not the fault itself.
opened not his mouth: But willingly and patiently obeyed his father's appointment, Mt 26:63, Ac 8:32.
prison and from judgment: From the cross and grave, after that he was condemned.
and who shall declare his generation: Though he died for sin, yet after his resurrection he will live forever and this his death is to restore life to his members, Ro 6:9.
And he made his grave with: God the Father delivered him into the hands of the wicked, and to the powers of the world to do with him what they would.
thou shalt make his soul an: Christ by offering up himself will give life to his Church, and so cause them to live with him forever.
travail of his soul: That is, the fruit and effect of his labour, which is the salvation of his Church.
righteous servant justify many: Christ will justify by faith through his word, while Moses could not justify by the law.
he hath poured out his soul: Because he humbled himself, therefore he will be extolled to glory, Php 2:7-2:12.
of many: That is, of all that believe in him.
